species_model: Human EC culture, mouse vascular models
experimental_observation: Endothelial junction-associated NME1 contributes to ATP production and actomyosin maturation
applicability_limitation: Junctional/intracellular activity is not native luminal receptor availability

species_model: Coronary endothelium, non-brain vascular prep
experimental_observation: Membrane-associated extracellular NDPK activity and surface-antibody binding reported
applicability_limitation: Protein sequence related to Nm23-H1, not definitive NME1-specific native BBB luminal test

species_model: Human hematopoietic and selected non-hematopoietic cell lines
experimental_observation: Surface reactive Nm23-H1/H2 antigens identified by flow cytometry and surface label
applicability_limitation: Cell lines, not human brain microvascular endothelial cells

species_model: Mouse breast cancer xenografts; human breast cancer context
experimental_observation: Circulating extracellular NM23 and purinergic-signalling impact on tumor growth/angiogenesis
applicability_limitation: Extracellular soluble NM23 can be decoy; P2Y1 is the proposed endothelial target, not NME1 transcytosis

species_model: Brain capillary luminal membrane fractions
experimental_observation: P-gp enriched in luminal membranes compared with contamination controls
applicability_limitation: Biochemical fractionation does not establish peptide binding/internalization

species_model: Human and rat brain capillaries, in-situ tissue
experimental_observation: Immunogold shows both luminal and abluminal capillary membranes
applicability_limitation: Protein presence is not incoming peptide cargo shuttle; polarity not simply exclusively luminal

species_model: WT and Abcb1/Abcg2 knockout mouse capillaries
experimental_observation: Measured transporter protein in isolated brain EC capillaries across genotypes
applicability_limitation: Mouse Abcb1a/Abcb1b is paralog context; not human BBB binding assay

species_model: Primary brain endothelial monolayers / mouse models
experimental_observation: LRP1/PICALM-associated amyloid-beta clearance linked to ABCB1 efflux machinery
applicability_limitation: Native Aβ clearance is brain-to-blood, ligand/process not de novo peptide shuttle

species_model: Human blood microvascular endothelium / HMEC-1
experimental_observation: Reported PAL-E-reactive extracellular vimentin
applicability_limitation: PAL-E antigen identity explicitly contradicted by Niemela2005; independent vimentin assays need separate review

species_model: Human endothelial immunostaining, immunoprecipitation and transfectants
experimental_observation: Identified PAL-E target as PLVAP/PV1 rather than VIM
applicability_limitation: Specific to PAL-E attribution; does not negate all independent VIM surface evidence

species_model: HUVEC and WT/Vim-null mouse lung EC
experimental_observation: Direct CD44-vimentin binding and vimentin-dependent internalization (30 min)
applicability_limitation: Not a native BBB capillary, not basolateral release, and not de novo peptide cargo

species_model: Human brain microvascular endothelial cells in culture
experimental_observation: IbeA–surface VIM interaction implicated in bacterial binding/invasion
applicability_limitation: Bacterial virulence-factor interaction does not prove non-disruptive peptide shuttle transport

species_model: Human brain microvascular endothelial cells / meningitic E. coli
experimental_observation: Vimentin head-domain interventions and phosphorylation modulate bacterial invasion
applicability_limitation: Pathogenic activation/ERK/CaMKII pathway and inflammatory risk; not therapeutic peptide release

species_model: HBMEC monolayer, pathogenic E. coli K1
experimental_observation: Bacterial invasion accompanied by endothelial injury, TEER and inflammatory pathway effects
applicability_limitation: Intact BBB shuttle would require separating harmless receptor access from pathogen-mediated disruption

species_model: HEK293T cells, KDELR1 perturbation
experimental_observation: KDEL motif and KDELR1 contribute to surface association; inhibitor-based PDIA6 trafficking observations
applicability_limitation: Non-brain cells; ER-retention and other interaction partners; no human native BBB demonstration

species_model: Mouse laser-injury thrombosis; platelet/EC assays
experimental_observation: Extracellular ERp5 affects platelets and fibrin; reported β3 integrin binding
applicability_limitation: Thrombus/wounded vessels are not healthy BBB; potential hemostatic off-target liability

species_model: Platelets / recombinant integrin mechanics
experimental_observation: ERp5 redox chemistry mediates fibrinogen de-adhesion under force
applicability_limitation: Integrin-redox process, not receptor-mediated peptide transcytosis

species_model: Developing and adult mouse CNS, choroid plexus, skin Miles assay
experimental_observation: AGM expressed in CNS developing vessels and non-BBB choroid plexus; counteracts VEGF skin leakage
applicability_limitation: Not a BBB inducer in their interpretation; secreted factor, not membrane transport receptor

species_model: Cultured vascular endothelial cells, Weibel-Palade organelles
experimental_observation: Proteomics identifies IGFBP7 as WPB granule resident
applicability_limitation: Secretion into blood could act as systemic sink, not stable membrane ectodomain

species_model: Human brain endothelial cells, glioblastoma conditioned media
experimental_observation: Tumor conditioned media induces IGFBP7; recombinant IGFBP7 promotes tube formation
applicability_limitation: Tumor vascular conditions differ from normal or stroke BBB

species_model: Mouse bEnd.3 endothelial OGD/reoxygenation in vitro
experimental_observation: IGFBP7 linked to cell survival/tight junctions and model barrier permeability
applicability_limitation: Different context from in vivo D02 upregulation; does not establish surface shuttle cargo route

species_model: Recombinant IGFBP7 cryo-EM and adhesion assays
experimental_observation: Heparin-dependent assembly of IGFBP7 homo-dodecamer; soluble adhesive interactions
applicability_limitation: Structural multimerization/glycan context essential; not a transmembrane receptor
